item.title: Plants that touch each other are more resilient to stress
item.description: New research has found when plant leaves physically touch each other, they seem to form a biological signalling network to warn each other about the upcoming stress. This can boost their resilience to withstand intense light, which is a common environmental challenge.Continue ReadingCategory: Biology, ScienceTags: Plants, Stress, Communications, Evolution

item.title: Mathematical thinking may have developed long before writing
item.description: We generally associate the origins of mathematical thinking with the emergence of writing, about five to six thousand years ago.
